Basic chat completion with a single user message

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    request = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"temperature\":0}")
    result = await client.chat(request)
    print(result.choices)
    print(result.choices[0].message.content)
    print(result.choices[0].finish_reason)
    print(result.usage.total_tokens)
    print(result.model)

asyncio.run(main())
```
